surfaces.label: Email verification grants ownership of an existing clinic
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20260423_fix_clinic_trigger.sql:20; The existing-profile guard blocks already assigned users, not fresh signups. clinics.owner_id is not overwritten; JWT-based authorization nevertheless grants owner capabilities.

surfaces.label: Staff can change their own role and clinic
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20251222_enforce_enums.sql:59; Enums validate values, not authority. No protecting column revoke or trigger was found. The direct profile consumers remain relevant without the hook.

surfaces.label: Users can join another clinic without an invitation
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20260525_db_verification_and_repair.sql:291; Later JWT patient policies have different names; permissive policies combine with OR. Foreign keys prove existence only.

surfaces.label: Patient statistics RPC discloses other clinics' health records
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20260525_db_verification_and_repair.sql:112; Search, pagination and soft-delete filtering are not tenant authorization. Earlier overloads are dropped; the secure profile RPC is a separate unused guard.

surfaces.label: Every authenticated user can read or delete all patient files
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20260526_create_patient_files_and_notes.sql:99; Private bucket status requires authentication but does not establish tenant isolation; patient_files metadata RLS is a separate control.

surfaces.label: Invitation action issues account capabilities without checking the caller
surfaces.notes: app/actions/invite-member.ts:6; The separate Edge invite handler has checks but is not this action. Existing-user behavior and invalid profile status pending limit takeover claims; unauthorized account invitation and token disclosure are supported.

surfaces.label: Receptionists can write clinical records through direct APIs
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20260508220424_enable_rls_prescriptions.sql:15; Owner-only prescription DELETE and clinical_records role checks do not protect these sibling tables. Impact is limited to the caller clinic absent separate escalation.

surfaces.label: Analytics view reveals other clinics' revenue and identifiers
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20260220_analytics_view.sql:5; January security_invoker migration changes only receptionist_patient_view and recall_queue, before this view is created.

surfaces.label: Maintenance RPCs permit unauthorized clinic changes under default grants
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20251227_data_retention_lifecycle.sql:9; Purge does not reliably delete populated clinics because non-CASCADE FKs block it. JWT caching can delay archival effects. Explicit external grant hardening could remove reachability.

surfaces.label: Public email endpoint sends arbitrary HTML to arbitrary recipients
surfaces.notes: app/api/send-email/route.ts:9; Missing key returns 503; no handler authentication, recipient ownership, template restriction or quota is present.

surfaces.label: Missing payment credentials can activate an unpaid subscription
surfaces.notes: lib/kushki.ts:73; Configured real merchant credentials rethrow failures. This is configuration-dependent financial integrity impact; no payment fraud was executed.

surfaces.label: A clinic owner can insert services into another clinic
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20260401_fix_admin_roles.sql:37; The tenant-bound FOR ALL policy does not restrict another permissive INSERT policy. Do not infer all cross-tenant UPDATE/DELETE operations without SELECT visibility.

surfaces.label: Authenticated users can change shared bank-payment configuration
surfaces.notes: supabase/migrations/20251214_billing_enhancements.sql:56; The later payments table replacement fixes a different table, not payment_methods. No proof of actual misdirected payments is claimed.
